title: Tourism Explorer
description: Shows real tourist attractions near a searched place (sights, museums, temples, forts, parks), with a map, weather and a day plan. It does not handle hotels, restaurants, bookings or transport.

supportedIntents.description: Broad questions about what to see or do in a city or area. Needs a place; no category.
example: best places to visit in Kurukshetra

supportedIntents.description: Questions asking for one kind of place (museums, temples, forts, monuments, viewpoints, parks, historic sites) in a city or area.

categories.description: Kind of place the user asked for. Map synonyms: museum (museums, galleries); temple (temples, mosques, churches, shrines, gurudwaras, places of worship); fort (forts, castles, palaces); monument (monuments, memorials); viewpoint (viewpoints, lookouts); park (parks, gardens); historic (historic/heritage sites, ruins); landmark (landmarks). Omit for a broad 'things to do' request. Never use the place name itself as a category (Newcastle, Fort Worth, Park City are places).

attributes.description: Extra information the user may want per place, e.g. 'description', 'distance', 'opening hours', 'directions', 'weather', 'day plan'. Use an empty array if none are requested.

schema.description: A request for tourist places in one location.

type.description: 'list' for a broad attractions request (no specific kind of place), 'query' when a specific category is requested.

filters.description: Narrow the attractions by kind of place.
